title: Half-increment derivative error bound
statement: Let $E$ be a real normed vector space and let $f:E\to\mathbb R$ be differentiable everywhere, with derivative $Df(x):E\to\mathbb R$. Suppose the derivative map is $C$-Lipschitz in operator norm for some $C\ge0$. For all $x,v\in E$ and $h\in\mathbb R$, \[\left|\frac{f(x+hv)-f(x)}{2}-\frac{h}{2}Df(x)[v]\right|\le \frac{C}{2}h^2\|v\|^2.\]
hypotheses_covered: $E$ is a real normed vector space
$f$ has a Fréchet derivative at every point, denoted $Df(x)$
$Df$ is $C$-Lipschitz in operator norm for some $C\ge0
